subject: Stakeholder mapping and procurement steps — Redwood pilot (Aurora Retail)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@auroraretail.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@auroraretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder mapping and procurement steps — Redwood pilot (Aurora Retail)

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the asks that will help us scope a short pilot and an initial commercial proposal: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary use case: personalized product recommendations in web checkout and in-app search.
- Success criteria: improve AOV by 5%, maintain sub-150ms p99 inference latency for live traffic, and no user-facing regressions.
- Timeline: pilot interested to start in January; decision expected by end of Q1.

What we need to keep momentum (asks):
1) Stakeholder/org chart — can you share the org chart or a list of who owns ML/product/engineering/procurement/legal/security (we want the economic buyer + security & procurement contacts).
2) Procurement process / PO terms — any standard SOW/MSA, purchase order timelines, and budget owner details.
3) Security checklist owners — who should we loop in for SOC2 / data residency / access controls questions.
4) Decision criteria — are there mandatory requirements (e.g., SSO, IP/data retention policies) we should be aware of?

Next steps I propose:
- If you can share an org chart or intro email to the people above, we'll draft a mutually actionable plan (timeline, scope, pilot success metrics).
- I'll pull together a short one-page pilot plan + preliminary pricing and the security FAQ for your security team.

Proposed times for a follow-up call to align on procurement steps: Nov 4th or Nov 5th — I'm flexible, let me know what works.

Thanks — appreciate the partnership.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0126
[attachment: Redwood_Pilot_Summary.pdf (PDF, 45KB)]
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@auroraretail.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@auroraretail.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@auroraretail.com>, procurement@auroraretail.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping and procurement steps — Redwood pilot (Aurora Retail)

Neha —

Thanks for the clear recap and next steps. Attaching the org chart (see file) which includes the product/engineering leads and the budget owner. A few quick notes:

- Org chart attached: Aurora_Org_Chart_v2.pdf (see top-level buyers list).
- Economic buyer: Tom Li (CTO) — he's cc'd here.
- Security/Compliance lead: Raj Patel — I've cc'd Raj for direct answers on SOC2 / data residency.
- Procurement general mailbox: procurement@auroraretail.com (they handle PO templates and vendor forms).

Decision criteria: cost per 1M tokens, latency at p99, and security/compliance (SOC2 + data residency in US). Budget is provisionally approved for a pilot up to $40k pending a short procurement review.

We can do Nov 4th at 1:00 PM EST for a procurement sync — I'll send a calendar invite after we confirm.

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot plan.

Best,
Samantha Ortiz
Director of Product Management
Aurora Retail
[attachment: Aurora_Org_Chart_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping and procurement steps — Redwood pilot (Aurora Retail)

Hi Samantha — thanks for the org chart, that's super helpful. A couple of quick asks from the solutions/security side so we can pre-fill the security questionnaire and avoid delays on the procurement side:

- Can you confirm whether Aurora requires SSO (SAML/Okta) for vendor consoles? If so, which IdP?
- Data residency: you mentioned US — can you confirm preferred region (us-east-1 / us-west-2) and whether any PII will be sent to the model?
- Procurement docs: if there's a standard MSA or redline list, can you paste or attach it so Legal can do an initial review?

I've attached a short security FAQ and a preliminary pricing summary to speed the review. If Raj is available before the procurement call, happy to do a 20-min sync to walk through the security answers.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_FAQ.pdf (security team answers), pricing_summary.pdf (pilot pricing bands).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0199
[attachment: Redwood_Security_FAQ.pdf (PDF, 85KB)]
[attachment: pricing_summary.pdf (PDF, 34KB)]

Neha / Marissa —

Confirming Nov 4th at 1:00 PM EST for the procurement/security sync. I've sent a calendar invite (attached) to the group. A few preliminary answers to Marissa's questions:

- SSO: yes, we use Okta (SAML).
- Data residency: prefer us-west-2 for primary storage; we can discuss replication needs if required.
- PII: minimal (hashed customer IDs) — will provide data samples under an NDA if needed.
- MSA: procurement@auroraretail.com has our standard PO template — I've asked them to share the template ahead of the call.

Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Samantha Ortiz
Director of Product Management | Aurora Retail
